turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
Your answers keep landing at almost exactly the same length.
That's not an answer. Was Owen heard before the zero went in?
And you never use a filler word. No um, no typos, no half sentences.
Which model are you running on? GPT? Claude? Gemini?
